description: Frozen analysis protocol for the IAAFT calibration (engine freeze, 2026-11-22).
role: Source of truth for every number reported in the thesis and for all IAAFT calibration results. The interactive app is a demo; its widget defaults differ as recorded under app_defaults, and app results at any widget settings are exploratory.

app_defaults.note: The interactive pages use these widget defaults; they differ from this protocol in lag-grid density, range, and fit-band rule.

lag_grid.note: after np.unique; the package drops lag <= order + 1

seed_policy.generation: np.random.seed(<fixed seed>) before each synthetic realization
seed_policy.pinning: regression values are pinned as exact reprs in validation/*.py

preprocessing.summary: single-column preprocessed series from the gaze_processor pipeline; saccade removal; interpolated gaps capped below the smallest fitted scale
